source.citation: Ribergaard (2010), Oceanographic Investigations off West Greenland 2009, NAFO SCR 10/004.
source.reviewed_scope: Extracted text, PDF pages 1-7; no figure digitization or complete visual review.

findings.finding: Cape Desolation to Upernavik describes report coverage, not paired current-axis endpoints.
The 500-800 m Irminger Water thickness is vertical water-mass structure, not horizontal current width. The circulation branches near Fylla Bank.
June 10-16 and June 20-July 18 are separate 2009 campaign intervals. Cape Farewell was skipped. Neither interval supplies exact occupation dates for all sections.

Reported methods concern temperature/salinity profiles; the reviewed passages establish no velocity-defined edges or connected axis. DMI stores quality-controlled data, ICES received copies, and GINR owns the data.

decision: Do not calculate a geographic bound from survey coverage or treat hydrographic layers as horizontal widths. Recover original section data, occupation dates and a current-identification method first.

next_primary_source.status: Author bibliography confirms citation; DOI retrieval failed in this review. Full original remains unreviewed.
